conventions: Errors are PostgreSQL P0001 exceptions: `message` is the error code, `details` a JSON object (PostgREST returns them as error.message / error.details). `match: exact` responses are deterministic and must be equal; `match: shape` responses fix keys and types — values marked <uuid>, <iso>, <seed> vary.
signature: search_content(p_q text, p_kinds text[] default null, p_node text default null, p_limit int default 10, p_offset int default 0, p_anon boolean default false) → jsonb
description: Groups node, resource, exam and (signed in only, never with p_anon) question — question hits are lesson-level counts, never stems; premium, unpublished and inactive items excluded. p_q ≥ 2 chars (≥ 3 for questions); totals capped at 100; statement_timeout 500 ms.

cases.name: anonymous callers get no question group
